_doc: Named production presets. Each is a complete set of build priorities (category:level, categories in sidecar/civ6_priorities.py). Applied through the synced set_build_priority path, so the native AI and the empty-queue fill both use it. Per seat, not per city. min_era: 0 ancient, 1 classical, 2 medieval, ... requires: any one of these techs/civics known (empty = none). Only available presets are listed in the prompt.

presets.desc: settlers only: every city builds settlers to found new cities fast (falls back to the normal fill when a city cannot build one)
